title: A website guest can cancel or reschedule from their own confirmation email

source.ref: Space booking audit 2026-11-21 (project thread: Make Space booking as robust as Calendly)

detail:
FOUND 2026-11-21 in code: rescheduleBooking and cancelBooking both require a signed-in member who is the booker (or an admin), and a guest row has no profile, so only the owner can move or cancel a guest booking. The guest's emails link to the website's Book page, which offers neither. Every Calendly invitee gets Cancel and Reschedule links. Fix: a per-booking manage token (the SCAN-834 confirm-token pattern, POST-only so a mail scanner cannot act), a small manage page on the site, and the same notice window the member path uses.

DONE 2026-11-21: a website guest's confirmation and reminder emails now link to a manage page (/manage-booking?token= on the published website, else /spaces/<slug>/manage-booking on Frequency, both sharing components/spaces/guest-booking-manage.tsx, dynamic and noindex). The secret is the existing guest_confirm_token, compared server-side only and bound to the page's Space. Opening the link writes nothing; Cancel (optional reason) and Move (same service's open times) are POST server actions, rate limited per IP. Both respect the schedule's minimum notice (withinModifyWindow). Cancel stamps cancelled_at and cancel_reason and sends notifyBookingCancelled; a move acquires the new slot first through validateAndPlaceBooking (rescheduled_from), cancels the old row, and moves the secret to the new booking. Logic in lib/spaces/booking-guest-manage.ts; cancelGuestBooking in lib/spaces/booking.ts is a thin wrapper. manage-booking is reserved as a page slug, kept on the free subdomain, and never inherited from a Network.

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
